thread_and_queue_evidence: The ETS DataShare helper and DataProxyHandle APIs use taskpool.execute for native calls. The reviewed direct result-set wrapper does not show taskpool dispatch. For taskpool APIs, this establishes asynchronous dispatch, not concurrent execution of two calls on the same object.

DataShareStubImpl request methods hold its mutex_ while synchronously submitting JsSyncCall/StsSyncCall. DataShareUvQueue routes JS work to napi_send_event and STS work to the main EventRunner/EventHandler, waits on a per-task condition variable, and uses an atomic task reference count. This serializes each entry's completion bookkeeping; it does not independently prove all object accesses are race-free.

No atomics were found on the candidate shared_ptr fields. Explicit locks occur in DataShareStubImpl queue dispatch and ObserverImpl registry operations, not around ANI holder members or ResultSetHolder::resultSetPtr_.
